conflictSeverity.rationale: Bundle-local conflicts are concentrated and well-shaped: (1) two files with genuine three-way merge work — web-app/cordis.patch.yml and web-app/package.json — where fork-additive rows/deps must survive alongside upstream rename and version bumps; (2) two low-risk deletions (sdk-minimal editor+fs-local drops) that align with fork's own str_replace_editor removal history; (3) one cross-seam refactor (AgentSetup arity) that ripples OUT of seam-1 into 4+ other test files owned by fork — this is not a seam-1 blocker but MUST be resolved in the same landing session or global typecheck breaks; (4) i18n README churn is mechanical, regenerator can absorb after human-resolves upstream Chinese text. Historical note: seam-1 has never previously been flagged as breaking (UM11-UM14 seam-1 sailed clean). Bundle patches remain a stable seam; the ripple risk (AgentSetup type) is what elevates this from low->medium.

recommendedApproach:
Three-way-manual for web-app/cordis.patch.yml and web-app/package.json (the two high-severity files carrying fork-additive shapes that must survive). Take-upstream-wholesale for sdk-minimal/{cordis.patch.yml,package.json,tests/sdk-minimal.spec.ts} (fork has no shape to defend there; upstream is deleting rows fork also wants gone per its own str_replace_editor removal work). Take-upstream-wholesale for base/cordis.patch.yml (single-value model swap) and base/package.json (additive tool-present dep). Take-upstream for headless/src/index.ts (one comment) and headless/tests/headless.spec.ts BUT gate the merge behind fixing AgentSetup callers in api/session-controller/tests/session-{presets,fork}.host.spec.ts and webhook/webhook/tests/{runtime,session}.spec.ts within the same landing commit — otherwise typecheck fails globally. Preserve packages/bundle/data-agent/* verbatim (fork-only). For i18n *.zh.md + *.i18n.yaml, take-upstream then re-run the fork's i18n pairing regenerator to refresh hashes.

Suggested sequence: (a) merge NEW into a working branch, resolve conflicts file-by-file in the order web-app/cordis.patch.yml -> web-app/package.json -> sdk-minimal/* (take-upstream) -> base/* (take-upstream) -> headless/* (take-upstream); (b) BEFORE landing, migrate the 4 out-of-seam AgentSetup call-sites to the (ownerCtx, agent) shape; (c) re-run i18n regenerator; (d) run testHotspots below; (e) verify-cordis-config gate must pass on all 5 bundles.
